name: factory-real-host-assurance
description: Use when proving Factory repeatability, reproducible product production, live host and nested-agent behavior, browser verification, or interruption and recovery. Keep operational assurance distinct from customer-value cycles and preserve failed attempts.

name: factory-recap
description: Catch the operator up on what changed since they last checked in and surface every decision waiting on them. Invoke only when the user explicitly asks to run /factory-recap or the factory-recap workflow.

name: factory-recap-video
description: Catch the operator up with a silent subtitled landscape MP4 walkthrough and self-contained decision cards. Invoke only when the user explicitly asks to run /factory-recap-video or the factory-recap-video workflow.

name: factory-recheck
description: Fresh-eyes, read-only re-review of your own just-finished implementation against the original requirements. Produces a PASS/WARN/FAIL table across correctness, bugs, duplication, conventions, docs, and security, plus a YES/NO verdict. The verification step of the factory pipeline; also usable standalone. Use when the user says "factory recheck", "recheck my work", or "review what I just did".

name: factory-recover
description: Find interrupted coding runs and report resume candidates. Use after a host restart or interrupted automation; resuming needs the action policy to allow it while the go-gate is off, otherwise the user's literal GO for this exact action.

name: factory-recover
description: Resume eligible interrupted runs without repeating completed actions.

name: factory-recover
description: Experimental workflow for finding and resuming interrupted coding runs. Use after an agent host restart or an interrupted automation.

name: factory-refine

Use when asked to refine, groom, scope, or clarify an issue.

name: factory-reflect
description: Analyze the current session transcript using three parallel read-only lenses (judgment, tooling, divergent) and a synthesizer to harvest durable project-specific skills, repo rules, or structural lint/check tickets. Contrasts with /factory-friction (Factory harness bugs) and /factory-retro (orchestrator logs/CI metrics). Use for /factory-reflect or 'what should we teach the repo from this session'.

name: factory-relay
description: Relay a human Linear signal or a merged factory PR event to the durable foreman, restarting only a finished or unreachable owner.

name: factory-release
description: Use when an approved PR head must reach production through a gated release — exact-head merge, staged canary rollout with threshold verdicts, a SemVer-tagged release with notes, milestone close and roadmap update, plus a monitor handoff. Triggers on post-merge rollout work; not for continuous monitoring, review depth, or infra provisioning.

name: factory-release
description: Cut a new release — bump package.json + VERSION in lockstep, commit, tag with a per-version breakdown since the last published baseline, push, publish a GitHub Release, and publish to npm. Five approval gates; the user edits release notes in their preferred editor.

name: factory-release
description: Prepare a truthful readiness handoff, perform only authorized release actions, and confirm actual targets.

name: factory-release
description: AI Factory release stage: assemble the release dossier from requirements, PR, review, and QA artifacts, run the merge gate checklist, obtain human approval, and set up rollout monitoring with follow-up or incident loops. Use for 'factory release', 'prepare the release dossier', merge readiness checks, 'можно ли мержить', post-QA approval requests, or rollout monitoring after a factory merge.

name: factory-releaser
description: Ship stage of the software factory. Re-runs the checks, archives the OpenSpec change into the main specs, and commits, pushes and opens a pull request as the config says. Use when the factory orchestrator spawns the ship stage after the human has approved shipping.

name: factory-remember
description: Turn a correction that just happened into a durable, concise checklist rule in the right Factory gate — plan review, code review, or QA — so the same class of defect gets caught before a human has to point at it again. Generalizes the incident into a rule, picks the earliest gate whose evidence can actually decide it, dedupes against what is already there, and never mentions the originating case. Use when the user says "factory remember", "remember this", "add this to the review", "make sure this doesn't happen again", or right after fixing something the user had to catch for you.

name: factory-replay
description: Re-run an AIDLC orchestrator run from a specific stage. Rolls the manifest back, archives output handoffs, and routes to the chosen stage.

name: factory-repo-gates
description: Route MANM and EMPM work to approved repositories and enforce branch, PR, test and merge gates.

name: factory-report
description: Linear status report across configured repos — queue depth, triage backlog, ready-to-dispatch, blocked/held. Invoke only when the user explicitly asks to run /factory-report or the factory-report workflow.

name: factory-report

Reports goal timing, agent cost, and the four execution failure signals (runaway, hung, stalled, oversized) across every repo with a docs/goals queue, from git history plus the factory event log. Strictly read-only — it measures the factory, never changes the queue, and never implements anything.

name: factory-requirements

name: factory-reresearch
description: Re-research an existing plan to find holes — missing requirements, anti-patterns, utils being re-created that already exist, functions used incorrectly. Updates the existing plan document in place rather than creating a new one. The hole-finding step of the factory pipeline; also usable standalone. Use when the user says "factory reresearch", "re-research the plan", or "find holes in the plan".

name: factory-rereview
description: Re-review a pull request after a push — reconcile the previous review against the new commits, look for new defects the push introduced, then a fresh pass over the whole PR, and finish with a verdict on the PR
